events.code_append:
-- gold.fct_grant_elduce_cross_reference
-- Grain: one row per (source_id, claim_date, attributed_to)
-- Joins Tom Grant investigation notes with El Duce interview segments
-- via the shared timeline anchor layer.
-- All claims represent allegations in identified sources — not established facts.
-- Official ruling: Seattle PD Case #94-108620 — suicide.

{{ config(
    materialized = 'incremental',
    unique_key   = 'cross_ref_id',
    schema       = 'gold'
) }}

with

grant_claims as (
    select
        note_id                             as source_id,
        'grant_investigation'               as source_type,
        note_date                           as claim_date,
        named_person                        as attributed_to,
        claim_text,
        source_url
    from {{ ref('stg_grant_investigation_notes') }}
    where named_person is not null
),

elduce_segments as (
    select
        transcript_segment_id               as source_id,
        'elduce_interview_transcript'        as source_type,
        segment_date                        as claim_date,
        coalesce(named_subject, speaker)    as attributed_to,
        text                                as claim_text,
        documentary_id                      as source_url
    from {{ ref('stg_elduce_interview_transcripts') }}
    where speaker = 'el_duce'
),

unioned as (
    select * from grant_claims
    union all
    select * from elduce_segments
),

with_anchors as (
    select
        u.*,
        a.anchor_id,
        a.event_date                        as anchor_date,
        a.corroborated_by_count,
        datediff('day', u.claim_date, a.event_date) as days_from_anchor
    from unioned u
    left join {{ ref('int_timeline_anchors') }} a
        on  u.attributed_to = a.named_person
        and abs(datediff('day', u.claim_date, a.event_date)) <= 14
),

final as (
    select
        {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['source_id', 'claim_date', 'attributed_to']) }}
            as cross_ref_id,
        source_id,
        source_type,
        claim_date,
        attributed_to,
        claim_text,
        source_url,
        anchor_id,
        anchor_date,
        corroborated_by_count,
        days_from_anchor,
        current_timestamp                   as dbt_updated_at
    from with_anchors
)

select * from final
{% if is_incremental() %}
where dbt_updated_at > (select max(dbt_updated_at) from {{ this }})
{% endif %}

events.code_append:
models:
  - name: fct_grant_elduce_cross_reference
    description: >
      Cross-reference of Tom Grant's investigation notes with El Duce's published
      interview segments, joined via timeline anchors. Grain: one row per
      (source_id, claim_date, attributed_to). All claims are allegations in
      identified published sources. Official ruling: suicide (Seattle PD, 1994).
    config:
      materialized: incremental
      schema: gold
    meta:
      owner: cobain_case_odi
      data_classification: public_source_only
      official_ruling: 'Seattle PD Case #94-108620 — suicide, 1994'
    columns:
      - name: cross_ref_id
        description: Surrogate key on (source_id, claim_date, attributed_to)
        tests:
          - unique
          - not_null
      - name: source_id
        description: Source-system record identifier
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_type
        description: Origin corpus type
        tests:
          - not_null
          - accepted_values:
              values: ['grant_investigation', 'elduce_interview_transcript']
      - name: claim_date
        description: Date of claim in source document
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: attributed_to
        description: Person to whom the claim refers or who made it
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: claim_text
        description: Verbatim claim text from source
      - name: anchor_id
        description: FK to int_timeline_anchors (nullable — not all claims resolve)
        tests:
          - relationships:
              to: ref('int_timeline_anchors')
              field: anchor_id
              severity: warn
      - name: corroborated_by_count
        description: Number of independent sources corroborating the linked anchor
      - name: days_from_anchor
        description: Days between claim_date and nearest timeline anchor date
